tasks.task: Write a ready-to-teach lesson plan

items.when: When next week's lessons are due and the pack must be built and checked in order
When you know the topic, class and lesson length and need a timed plan with an exit ticket
When the skill is new, to shape the lesson as show it, practise together, then alone
When the class can attempt it first, to try a version where the explanation comes second
When the lesson needs a five-minute start that brings back last lesson
When each stage needs a quick check of who has it before the class moves on
When the plan is drafted, to cut overload and fix barriers before it is taught

tasks.task: Plan a unit with outcomes, lessons and assessment points

items.when: When the unit needs a run of up to six lessons written out and timed
Before any lesson, to plan from the end result and the proof of learning backward
When you want one guided run from standards to a unit with mixed practice and revision
When topics are taught in blocks and should be mixed so learners must choose the method
When the unit holds a topic that is hard to teach and you need the usual mistakes first
When lessons are built around fun activities and not around what learners will think about

tasks.task: Write explanations and worked examples for a topic

items.when: When an idea needs the smallest example that still shows how it works
When a procedure needs a run from fully worked examples to solving alone
When the teacher must model the thinking out loud and needs the words
When an example is written, to add questions that make learners explain the why
When the explanation uses terms the learners do not have yet

tasks.task: Make worksheets at three levels with answer keys

items.when: When one worksheet must reach the same goal for learners at three levels
When you need problems that rise in difficulty and vary just enough
When one learner need is known, to see the same task adapted with the goal kept
When the support version needs hints that help bit by bit without giving the answer
When the sheets are drafted, to find words and sentences that block learners

tasks.task: Write a practice or homework set with worked answers

items.when: When a skill needs a graded set of problems to practise
When you have one worked example and want staged problems that fade the help
When learners keep making one mistake, to try examples with that mistake built in
When you have learners' wrong answers and the set should target the top mistakes

tasks.task: Write a quiz with an answer key and explanations

items.when: When the quiz must come from the client's own material with a key you can trust
When you have lesson notes and need a low-stakes recall quiz at three levels
When a question must show who understands and which wrong idea the rest hold
When the quiz is drafted, to check it tests the goals and not reading speed or tricks

tasks.task: Build an end-of-unit or end-of-course test and mark scheme

items.when: When a test needs a blueprint of what is tested, the paper and a mark scheme
When the test needs a longer task where learners weigh evidence or test a claim
Before the test is printed, to check each question against the outcomes taught
When questions use names, places or settings, to find hidden assumptions

tasks.task: Write a marking rubric for an essay, project or task

items.when: Before the rubric, to fix which outcomes the task is meant to show
When you have the task and its goal and need clear wording for each level
When a full grid is too heavy, to try one standard with room for evidence and next steps
When the rubric is drafted, to trial it on real work and see where it fails

tasks.task: Build a question bank ready for an LMS

items.when: When a course needs many questions tagged by outcome and level with keys
When each question should reveal a known wrong idea, not only right or wrong
Before import, to check the bank covers every outcome and none twice over

tasks.task: Adapt a lesson so every learner can reach the same goal

items.when: When one lesson or sheet needs scaffolds and supports with the goal unchanged
Before adapting, to find which barriers this class will hit in this lesson
When you want several ways to present, engage and let learners show what they know
When you have the lesson files and want adapted activities with the goal checked
When the adapted version is done, to find barriers that remain, ranked

tasks.task: Add language support for learners of English

items.when: Before adding support, to find the words and sentence types that will block learners
When learners need sentence starters at several English levels for one task
When a task needs language help added while the thinking stays just as hard
When key words must be taught first, shown, named and checked
When learners must write a set text type, like a lab report, and need a frame

tasks.task: Write a cover lesson a non-specialist can run

items.when: When a teacher is absent and the cover teacher does not teach the subject
When the cover lesson needs a self-running practice set with answers
Before it is left on the desk, to check a stranger could follow it

tasks.task: Map a year or course before lessons are planned

items.when: Before a new year, intake or syllabus change, or after coverage gaps are found
When you need units, outcomes and assessment points mapped to the syllabus
When the order is open, to see what to teach and when so each part builds on the last
When one skill runs through the year and needs steps from first prerequisite to mastery
When the map needs dates that bring each topic back before the exam
When the year teaches each topic once and never asks learners to recall it again

tasks.task: Check a scheme of work against the standards

items.when: When a scheme of work exists and you need outcomes never taught or never checked
When you have the curriculum and a list of requirements and want a coverage table
When gaps are found and the map must be rebuilt to close them

tasks.task: Build a resource list for each unit

items.when: Before listing resources, to know each unit's outcomes and assessment points
When the course is at college level and needs recent papers by topic
When a resource makes factual claims and must be checked before learners see it

tasks.task: Turn exit ticket or quiz results into a reteach plan

items.when: When you have today's results and need what to reteach tomorrow and how to check it
When errors cluster, to find the likely cause behind each before reteaching
When results sit in an LMS export and need reading into class actions
When this repeats each week and the next quiz should check the reteach worked

tasks.task: Mark student work and write feedback they can act on

items.when: When a batch of work must be marked against one rubric the same way
When one piece needs exactly what is missing against the criteria
When comments are drafted, to turn them into steps a student can take

tasks.task: Make revision notes, flashcards and a revision plan

items.when: When you have the syllabus and past papers and need what to revise ranked
When notes or a chapter must become cards with one question and one short answer
When topics and exam dates are known and revision needs spacing out
When learners should test themselves instead of rereading the notes
When the revision pack is mostly rereading and highlighting

tasks.task: Design discussion and group tasks for a lesson

items.when: When a topic needs talk, to compare formats and get the steps to run the best fit
When group work goes wrong and the task needs roles that share the thinking
When learners should weigh evidence or spot bias, not only recall
When the task is set, to add a check that shows what each learner took from it

tasks.task: Plan a project or inquiry unit

items.when: When a topic should become a project with a driving question, milestones and marking
When a local need could carry the unit and still meet the curriculum goals
When the project needs a rubric learners see before they start
When the project is planned, to check it assesses the outcomes and not presentation polish

tasks.task: Check an AI-made resource or AI tool for classroom use

items.when: When a school wants to use an AI-made resource or tool directly with under-18s
When an assignment needs clear lines on where AI may help and where it would replace learning
When the class itself needs lessons on checking AI answers and fair rules
When learners need a step-by-step way to check AI claims and citations

tasks.task: Plan a year of member education

items.when: Two to three months before the programme year, to plan it by member segment
When member skills gaps must become ranked needs, objectives and a programme
After a course, to see whether it changed what members do at work

tasks.task: Plan a webinar series with speaker briefs and invites

items.when: When an association wants a series, speaker briefs and a CPD record members can keep
When one webinar needs a teaching outline and slides that reach one clear result
When a speaker is chosen and the brief should fit how they present
When each webinar needs invites, reminders and a follow-up
Before an invite goes to members, to score it and get subject line options

always.when: Before any lesson material is handed over, to cut overload and fix barriers
Before learners see it, to check the facts in notes, questions and answer keys
When material uses examples from daily life, to find assumptions that shut learners out

helpers.when: When the course will run online or self-paced and needs storyboards and modules
When the learners are staff and the programme must tie to job skills
When one learner needs the material explained and practised one to one
When a lesson or webinar needs designed slides, not only the text
When materials are needed in a home language as well as English
When a member programme needs a full invite and reminder sequence

gaps: No library item writes a cover lesson for a non-specialist; only the kit prompt does
No library item builds a full test paper with a blueprint of marks by outcome and a mark scheme
No library item writes multiple-choice questions with wrong options built from known mistakes
No library item formats a question bank for LMS import, such as GIFT, QTI or a CSV layout
No library item checks an answer key by working each answer again from scratch
No library item makes visual schedules, task cards or other picture supports
No library item rewrites one text at three reading levels; the only simplifier is for history sources
No library item holds named standards such as a national curriculum or exam board syllabus to map against
No library item builds a resource list for a school unit; the reading list item finds academic papers
No library item builds classroom slides for a lesson
No library item plans a yearly member education calendar by segment or drafts a CPD record or certificate
No library item writes a speaker brief or a learner feedback survey for a course or webinar
No library item writes a note to parents about a unit, homework or a test
